info.name: Customer Complaint Management API
info.description:
Walks the complaint workflow: filing, own-only visibility, the priority-ordered queue, assignment, the one-step status flow (closed is final), mandatory resolution notes, customer feedback, the timeline, statistics and security.
Start the backend first (http://localhost:8117). Repeatable: it registers a fresh customer and creates uniquely titled complaints each run.

item.name: Register a fresh customer for this run

exec: pm.test("Six categories, four priorities", () => { const m = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(m.categories.length).to.eql(6); pm.expect(m.priorities).to.eql(["LOW", "MEDIUM", "HIGH", "URGENT"]); });

pm.test("Open, with a reference, nobody assigned", () => { pm.expect(c.status).to.eql("OPEN"); pm.expect(c.number).to.match(/^CMP-\d+$/); pm.expect(c.assigneeUsername).to.eql(null); pm.expect(c.canRate).to.be.false; });

item.name: File a second, low priority one
Another customer sees none of them
Open my own, with its timeline

exec: pm.test("One event: filed", () => { const d = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.timeline.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(d.timeline[0].type).to.eql("FILED"); });

item.name: The unassigned queue, most urgent first

exec: pm.test("High before low", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(l[0].priority).to.eql("HIGH"); });
pm.test("Assigned, still open", () => { const c = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(c.assigneeUsername).to.eql("kiran.bhat"); pm.expect(c.status).to.eql("OPEN"); });

item.name: Put it back in the queue
Skipping to resolved is a conflict

exec: pm.test("In progress and owned by the agent", () => { const c = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(c.status).to.eql("IN_PROGRESS"); pm.expect(c.assigneeUsername).to.eql("agent"); });

item.name: Starting it again is a conflict
Work in progress cannot be left without an owner
Rating before it is resolved is a conflict

exec: pm.test("Resolved, rating now possible", () => { const c = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(c.status).to.eql("RESOLVED"); pm.expect(c.resolution).to.eql("Duplicate charge reversed"); pm.expect(c.canRate).to.be.true; });
pm.test("Rated, no longer ratable", () => { const c = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(c.rating).to.eql(4); pm.expect(c.feedback).to.eql("Quick fix"); pm.expect(c.canRate).to.be.false; });

item.name: A resolved complaint can go back to in progress

exec: pm.test("Closed, nothing further", () => { const c = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(c.status).to.eql("CLOSED"); pm.expect(c.allowedNext).to.eql([]); });
